# Repository artwork

The repository presentation follows the live archive: charcoal `#09090a`, warm white `#f4f3f0` and gold `#ecc786`, with the existing wave mark and Anton display type.

- `cover.svg` is the editable, self-contained vector cover. Display lettering is outlined from the bundled Anton font so GitHub does not need to load a font. Its accessible title is supplied in the root README’s image alternative. Anton’s [SIL Open Font License](../../assets/images/fonts/OFL.txt) is preserved with the font.
- `preview.webp` is an actual screenshot of the homepage, captured at a 1440 × 900 CSS-pixel viewport with reduced motion. The frame contains the collection grid plus 24 pixels of surrounding space. Refresh it when the homepage changes; keep the screenshot faithful to the site and retain the existing [artwork provenance](../notes/IMAGE_SOURCES.md).

These files support the GitHub README and do not change the public site. Keep navigation and essential information as real text in the README, with descriptive alternatives for both images. Preview the README in light and dark mode and at a narrow mobile width after changing it.
